description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android TV application that hosts a dashboard and settings fragments, manages sidebar navigation, and handles focus traversal suitable for TV remote navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the entry point of the Smart Home TV app, managing navigation between Dashboard and Settings fragments with focus handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, sidebar, and default fragment, and sets initial focus.

methods.name: setupSidebar
methods.description: Configures focus behavior, colors, and click listeners for sidebar navigation items.

methods.name: showSection
methods.description: Displays the selected section’s fragment and shows a toast notification indicating the active section.
